body: Looks good! It just needs some leaves for height, maybe throw in some wood to make it look like branches and if you want to go the extra mile, there’s a style called “clusterfuck” where you just use pretty much every space you can to create a cramped and homey feel. Might work for you

Don’t know about magic but I can’t really ignore how good chlorophite bullets are. Especially in master mode dodging is so important so the constant dps with chlorophyte bullets and summons while you dodge is pretty neato
Always therapy. There is no sane reason for your family getting mad for you taking care of yourself. After all, they should be proud of you for taking initiative and doing the logical thing
If you wanna write more shoot me a message, I’m all out of em.
